rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for receiving property, money, or a title through succession.

example.english: When my dad passes away, I will inherit his shop.
example.traditional: 第時阿爸過身，我就會繼承佢間舖。
example.jyutping: dai6 si4 aa3 baa4 gwo3 san1 ngo5 zau6 wui5 gai3 sing4 keoi5 gaan1 pou3

rows.note: Use this for a physical or mental characteristic passed genetically from a parent or ancestor.

example.english: I may inherit my mother's asthma.
example.traditional: 我可能會遺傳到阿媽嘅哮喘。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ho2 nang4 wui5 wai4 cyun4 dou3 aa3 maa1 ge3 haau1 cyun2

rows.note: Use this, especially in formal or written contexts, for inheriting a tradition, system, or social condition from the past.

example.english: We inherit the system left by the previous generation.
example.traditional: 我哋承襲咗上一代留下嘅制度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sing4 zaap6 zo2 soeng6 jat1 doi6 lau4 haa6 ge3 zai3 dou6
